name: v0.3.67 — Combined GuacMoney + WebView close button
releaseNotes:
• GuacMoney is one balance now: money saved (not-worth-it ratings + refunds, $-for-$) + points for scanning (+100) and referring (+1,000). Redeem for gift cards — coming soon.
• Dashboard banner shows how many new Steals were found overnight on your saved searches.
• In-app web screens: tap the X (next to refresh) to close; the duplicate heading is gone; closing refreshes your data so ratings update GuacMoney.
